Rodrigo, I'm writing a short introduction about you for the New York team. Can I ask some questions?
Of course. Go ahead.
No, I've never worked abroad, but I've visited our plants in France many times.
Great. Have you ever managed a product launch?
Yes, I have. I've managed three launches in Brazil, with the team in Paris.
And have you ever had an audit from a big customer?
Yes, many times. We've had audits from global customers, and we've passed all of them.
Impressive! And how long is your career in supply chain?
About twenty years. It's a lot of experience, and I've learned something every year.

Hi everybody, it's Claire. Welcome to our new director in Shanghai, Mr. Li. Mr. Li has worked in supply chain for fifteen years. He has worked in China, Germany and Mexico, and he has managed four new plants. He has never lived in Europe, so if you see him in Paris, please say hello! Have a great week.

Hi Rodrigo, Tom here. A question for your visit. Have you ever been to a baseball game? If not, we have tickets for a Yankees game on Saturday. I've been to many games, and it's a great experience. And have you ever eaten a New York hot dog? It's part of the game! Let me know.
